product_family: Khan Academy is a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit education platform (free K-12/college video lessons and practice). Khanmigo is its GPT-4-based AI tutor/teaching-assistant product, offered directly to individual learners/parents/teachers and, separately, bundled into Khan Academy Districts for schools; Khan Academy Kids is a distinct app for under-13 users with its own privacy policy.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Khan Academy performs regular security compliance assessments and undergoes an annual external penetration test and annual SOC2 Type2 audits.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence: no mention of ISO 27001 on khanacademy.org, support.khanacademy.org, or khanmigo.ai; a third-party scanner (Nudge Security) labels Khan Academy 'ISO 27001 Compliant' but this is not a vendor-domain claim and could not be corroborated.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Khan Academy is an education product governed by FERPA/COPPA/PPRA, not a covered entity; no vendor page references HIPAA. (A third-party scanner separately mislabels it 'HIPAA Compliant' with no vendor-side support.)

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a PCI DSS attestation on any Khan Academy-controlled domain.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Despite Khanmigo being an AI-tutor product built on GPT-4, no AI-governance certification is referenced on any Khan Academy domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found; not applicable, Khan Academy sells to K-12 districts, not as a federal cloud service.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: Pursuant to the General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR"), if you are a resident of the European Economic Area ("EEA"), we process your personal information under the following lawful bases... If you are a resident of the EEA, you have the right to access the Personal Information we hold about you, to port it to a new service, and to ask that your Personal Information be corrected, updated, or erased.

privacy.ai_training_note: Khan Academy states content submitted by teachers and students through Khanmigo is not used to train the underlying AI models, and that it does not allow OpenAI (its LLM provider) to train models on student/teacher data or share names/personal information with the LLM provider. Data collected via Khanmigo is described as used only internally to improve the product, not sold. For school partnerships, Khan Academy signs Student Data Privacy Agreements (e.g. via the SDPC/A4L Resource Registry and state-specific templates such as an Ed Law 2D-compliant NY DPA) asserting FERPA/COPPA/PPRA compliance.
privacy.data_region: Primary hosting is the US (Google Cloud Platform / Google Cloud Run, per Khan Academy's own security-practices Help Center article). For the separate Khan Academy Store (merchandise, not the core learning/Khanmigo product), the vendor's own policy states EEA personal information is 'initially processed in Ireland and then will be transferred outside of Europe for storage and further processing, including to Canada and the United States.' No dedicated EU-region hosting was found for the core platform.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Personal information is encrypted when stored at rest.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Personal information is protected with encryption during transmission over the public internet; Khan Academy's Help Center states support for TLS 1.3, AES256 encryption, and SHA256 signatures.

security.name: Hosting infrastructure
security.value: Website and mobile app hosted on Google Cloud Platform (Google Cloud Run), US region; GCP-encrypted at rest with an additional encryption layer applied to personal data.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual external penetration test, alongside annual SOC 2 Type II audits.

security.name: Incident response
security.value: Documented incident response plan (detection/reporting, communication, isolation, resolution, post-mortem) exercised at least annually.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Public vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty program hosted on HackerOne.

security.name: No third-party advertising / no data sale
security.value: Khan Academy states it does not sell personal information and does not display third-party advertising; it is a signatory of the Student Privacy Pledge.

products.name: Khan Academy (core platform)
products.category: Free K-12/college video lessons and practice
products.data_scope: Learner account, progress/mastery data, optional school rostering
products.notes: Free, ad-free, nonprofit; consumer and school use.

products.name: Khanmigo (Learner/Parent)
products.notes: $4/month subscription for learners and parents (up to 10 children per parent account); GPT-4-based, built with OpenAI as the underlying LLM provider.

products.name: Khan Academy Districts / Khanmigo for Districts
products.data_scope: Student rostering data (via Clever/ClassLink), education records (FERPA), classroom AI tutoring interactions
products.notes: Per-student annual pricing (roughly $5-15/student/year depending on tier); custom Enterprise pricing above ~1,000 licenses; includes signed Student Data Privacy Agreements, automated rostering, and dedicated implementation support.

products.name: Khan Academy Kids
products.data_scope: Child account data (under 13), governed by a separate Kids Privacy Policy with its own GDPR/COPPA provisions
products.notes: Distinct app and privacy policy from the main khanacademy.org Children's Privacy Notice.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: core platform is free; Khanmigo is a paid consumer add-on ($4/month for learners/parents, free for teachers); Khan Academy Districts uses per-student annual licensing with custom Enterprise pricing above ~1,000 students.
compare.data_residency: US-primary (Google Cloud Platform); no dedicated EU/EEA data region identified for the core learning/Khanmigo product (the separate merchandise Store processes EEA data in Ireland before transferring to Canada/US).

flags: No dedicated public trust center or security page: khanacademy.org/security, /trust, /trust-center, /compliance, and /legal/privacy all return 404; compliance facts are scattered across a Help Center (Zendesk-hosted support.khanacademy.org) article instead of a formal trust portal or downloadable SOC 2 report/bridge letter.

A third-party security-scanning tool (Nudge Security) publicly labels Khan Academy as 'HIPAA Compliant, SOC 2 Compliant, GDPR Compliant, and ISO 27001 Compliant.' No vendor-domain evidence supports the ISO 27001 or HIPAA portions of that claim.
No AI-governance-specific certification (ISO/IEC 42001, CSA STAR for AI) was found despite Khanmigo being a GPT-4-based AI tutoring product; this is common for the market segment.
